title: fix(plugin-hono-server): allow If-None-Match and expose ETag in the default CORS policy
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XSVi3D9xHiawX2ZeUzaNoQt)_

Fixes #28970

Clause-②: yes (widening) — two exported default lists each gain one value: `DEFAULT_CORS_ALLOW_HEADERS` gains `If-None-Match` and `DEFAULT_CORS_EXPOSE_HEADERS` gains `ETag`. A cross-origin client the policy already admits may now send one more request header and read one more response header. Allowed origins are unchanged. No `packages/spec/**` file is touched.

Metadata-protocol: none — nothing a metadata author writes is read differently; this is the transport's CORS answer.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:默认 CORS 策略的两个列表各加一项:预检允许的请求头加 `If-None-Match`,对跨域 JS 暴露的响应头加 `ETag`。`@objectstack/plugin-hono-server` 和 `@objectstack/hono` 两处都读这两个常量,所以两处一起生效。允许的来源(origin)不变。
- 为什么改:服务器自己的门就在用这两个头:`/meta` 草稿保存认 `If-None-Match: *`(控制台首次存草稿发的就是它),元数据读返回 `ETag`、SDK 的缓存读会把它当 `If-None-Match` 发回来。原来的默认列表放行了 `If-Match` 却没放行 `If-None-Match`,也没暴露 `ETag`,所以前端和服务器不同源时,首次存草稿和缓存读在浏览器里直接报 `Failed to fetch`,请求根本到不了服务器。
- 风险与回滚:纯加法,两个列表各多一个值;未被允许的来源仍拿不到任何 `Access-Control-Allow-Origin`。自定义了 `allowHeaders` 的部署行为不变(仍是整体替换默认值)。回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server/src/adapter.ts` 的两个常量及其注释;新测试 `packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server/src/cors-conditional-headers.test.ts`;`packages/adapters/hono/src/hono.test.ts` 里新增的两条 pin。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-hono-server exec vitest run src/cors-conditional-headers.test.ts`,预期 `Tests 5 passed (5)`。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **`packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server/src/adapter.ts`**: `DEFAULT_CORS_ALLOW_HEADERS` gains `'If-None-Match'` (right after `'If-Match'`), and `DEFAULT_CORS_EXPOSE_HEADERS` gains `'ETag'`. Each docblock gets a line saying which door needs the entry, in the style of the `If-Match` line: the `/meta` draft save's first-write pin and the cached metadata reads for `If-None-Match`, and the version the metadata reads answer for `ETag`.
- **`content/docs/protocol/kernel/http-protocol.mdx`**: the documented default headers, the table of easy-to-overlook allowed headers (a new `If-None-Match` row) and the exposed-headers paragraph (now three, with `ETag`) match the new defaults. Leaving them would have made the published page false.
- **`.changeset/28970-cors-conditional-headers.md`**: `@objectstack/plugin-hono-server` patch, with both declaration lines. `Metadata-protocol: none` grades it `patch`. It says what a deployment with its own `allowHeaders` has to add.

## Tests

- New `packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server/src/cors-conditional-headers.test.ts` (5 cases), driven through the real `HonoServerPlugin.init()`, the real adapter and the real `hono/cors` middleware (`app.request`), not a captured config. A stand-in for the metadata item door is mounted behind the middleware: its read answers `ETag: "v1"`, and its draft save answers `200`.
  - A preflight from an admitted origin for `PUT …?mode=draft` asking `content-type,if-none-match,authorization` is answered `204` with `if-none-match` in `Access-Control-Allow-Headers`.
  - A cross-origin read of the item answers `Access-Control-Expose-Headers` including `etag`.
  - Controls: a disallowed origin gets no `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` on the preflight or the read; `If-Match` stays allowed, and `set-auth-token` and `x-objectstack-dropped-fields` stay exposed; a custom `allowHeaders` still replaces the default (exactly `content-type, authorization`, no `if-none-match`).
- `packages/adapters/hono/src/hono.test.ts`, beside the existing expose-headers pins: `createHonoApp` exposes `etag` by default, and a preflight from a configured origin asking `if-match,if-none-match` is answered with both allowed.
- **Red on base, green on head.** On `ab085a04` (base) the two new plugin cases and the two new adapter cases are red (`expected [ 'content-type', …(7) ] to include 'if-none-match'`, `expected [ 'set-auth-token', …(1) ] to include 'etag'`), and the three controls are green. On the head all are green.
- **Ablation** (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, both anchors hit once, on-disk count of each entry 0 afterwards): with the two entries removed, the plugin file reds 2 failed / 3 passed and the adapter group reds 2 failed / 4 passed, the same two failures each. Restore: the blob equals HEAD's (`69a105b3`), `git diff HEAD` is empty, and the plugin file is green again (5/5). Both suites read `adapter.ts` as source (the plugin test imports it relatively, and the hono adapter's `vitest.config.ts` aliases `@objectstack/plugin-hono-server` to `src/index.ts`), so no build sits on the path.

## Acceptance notes

- **Every site that reads the two lists** (measured with `git grep`): `packages/plugins/plugin-hono-server/src/hono-plugin.ts` (the plugin's CORS block) and `packages/adapters/hono/src/index.ts` (`createHonoApp`). No other site builds its own allow or expose list, so there is no third spelling to fold. The `adapter.ts` docblock still says "three Hono-based CORS sites", and so does a comment in `hono.test.ts`, but only these two read the constants today. That count is stale wording, left untouched (outside this card's file surface).
- **Server doors that read `If-None-Match` or answer `ETag`**: the `/meta` draft save (`@objectstack/rest` `meta-save-request.ts`, through `metaSaveRequestOptions`, which the runtime dispatcher's `/meta` door also reads); the metadata item read (`meta-item-read-routes.ts`, `ETag` and `304`); the metadata representation validator (`meta-representation-validator.ts`); the translations read (`packages/runtime/src/domains/i18n.ts`); plugin-hono-server's current-user endpoints (`current-user-endpoints.ts`); and cloud-connection's runtime config (`runtime-config-plugin.ts`). Producers on the client side: `@objectstack/client`'s `getCached` and `getAppBundle`, objectui's Studio first-draft saves and `DraftConflictDialog`, and `useETagCache`.
- Allowed origins, methods, credentials and `maxAge` are unchanged, and no other header is added (order ruling).
- No real cross-origin browser probe was run. The order lists it as optional, and the card's own Chromium measurement is the reach.

## Verification

Local gates were run on tree `f103bad4`, which is the tree of head `ae2b0b73` (the head only rewords the commit message of `71cfe728`).

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-hono-server test`: Test Files 38 passed (38), Tests 472 passed (472).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/hono test`: Test Files 14 passed (14), Tests 233 passed (233).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-hono-server typecheck` (including `check:test-typecheck`) and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/hono typecheck`: exit 0.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the three touched source files: exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 92 families. 91 exit 0. One, `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, is NOT MEASURED, reason: it exits 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET) until every package in the repo is built (33 packages have no `dist/`), and a whole-repo build was out of the local budget. Its self-test passed (93 cases), and CI's run is the reading. `check:plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` and `spec check:skill-examples` first exited 3 on prerequisites (a shallow object, an unbuilt `client-react`) and both exited 0 once those were met. `dispatch-gates --ran` over the exit-coded record: `92 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 91 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)`.
